scope: Evaluation matrix only. Each executable protocol must separately freeze exact environment IDs, task rows, seeds, budgets, checkpoints, and statistical estimands before accessing its evaluation tasks.

comparisons.target_claim: TF-SN is clearly better than MEGA
TF-SN is better than SGM and competitive with reported HIQL

baseline_decisions.sorb_reason: Removed to reduce training cost; SGM is the closer edge-correcting comparison.
baseline_decisions.hiql_reason: Use the published reported result as the single representative of the strongest maze baseline family; do not present it as a matched rerun.

scheduling_rules.antmaze_giant_gate: Do not start AntMaze giant until the predeclared AntMaze large success gate passes.

discontinued_work.program: Gymnasium PointMaze and AntMaze aligned multi-seed freeze/rebuild r16
discontinued_work.artifact_policy: Preserve completed artifacts as development history until an explicit reviewed cleanup; they are not evidence for the frozen OGBench-centered panel.
discontinued_work.method_status: The R74 method specification remains the implementation reference. Discontinuing the old benchmark campaign does not change the method.

reporting_constraints: Keep hidden-goal and supplied-goal results separate.
Label HIQL values as reported rather than matched reruns.
Do not report AntMaze giant unless its large-domain gate was declared and passed.
Report the direct-executor ablation on exactly the matched task rows used for TF-SN.
Do not merge the discontinued Gymnasium maze rebuild evidence into this panel.
FetchPush remains in the panel as an explicit non-OGBench transfer domain.
